## Module docstrings (CLI contracts, verbatim)

### bench.py
```
CP50 bench instrument, policy v1 (recon-factory Phase 7).

Loads the frozen G0 draw in stored order, plans one-fresh-process cohorts, defines the per-function record schema
`ksr.recon.bench_record/1`, locks the arm-A threshold before arm B can be read (CD#27) and evaluates the criterion.

It imports nothing outside the standard library (GAP-3) and never opens G0_HOLDOUT.json. The arm executor
(candidates -> cohort capsule -> GEX44 -> repatriate -> records) is NOT here: it is injected. A real arm with no
executor is refused ARM_EXECUTOR_ABSENT and nothing is written.
```

### m2c_producer.py
```
W2.2 — second L1 producer: m2c over DTK's own asm, one isolated record per function.

    <venv>\python.exe m2c_producer.py <corpus.jsonl> <asm_root> <out_dir> [--module main] [--ids ids.txt]

Runs ONLY under the factory venv (pinned, hash-locked deps; TOOLS.json) and the pinned m2c checkout
(GPL-3.0, used as an external tool, never copied into this repo). One process calls m2c's own
parse_flags/run per function (a subprocess per function measured 0.9 s each: ~10 h for the corpus);
each call is isolated by try/except and its stdout captured, so one failure never touches another row.
Record (results.tsv): id status seconds m2c_errors c_sha256 error. L1 admission for this producer:
status OK and zero `M2C_ERROR` markers. Text from m2c is an observation, never source truth.
Resumable: ids already in results.tsv are skipped.
--valid-syntax (default off): pass m2c's own --valid-syntax flag (output uses the macros of the pinned checkout's
m2c_macros.h instead of `?` unknown types); the Phase 5 `m2c.valid_syntax` arm. Record format and admission unchanged.
```

### candidate.py
```
New candidates on GEX44 (plan 03-01, D-05 / D-08 / D-11 / D-12): the units a `candidate` job carries, the second
oracle, and the two-oracle judge of the returned bytes.

    python candidate.py judge <job_id>
        -> CAND_JUDGE=<OK|STALE_INPUT|INVALID_CUSTODY|ERROR> units=N match=M partial=P blocked=B      (exit 0 OK)
    python candidate.py audit [--path <candidate_ledger.jsonl>]
        -> CAND_AUDIT=OK matches=N proven=N | CAND_AUDIT=FAIL matches=N proven=K <reasons>

A unit is generated C (inline `source_text`, sha256-checked), literal flags and a target object of the VERIFIED
capsule. GEX44 compiles and objdiffs; it never judges. A new candidate is MATCH_CANDIDATE only when the returned object
re-hashes to what the receipt says, objdiff reported 100.0 against the capsule target, AND the second oracle - decomp's
match.py `judge`, run HERE on the RETURNED bytes against the retail DOL words and the DTK operands - says MATCH with
every relocation verified. Either oracle alone is never a candidate.

The oracle tree (wt_keosdtk_home) is read-only: match.py / corpus.py are imported only after
`sys.dont_write_bytecode = True`, attempt.py is never imported (its import creates factory directories), and
`oracle_stat_digest` lets a drill prove the tree did not move.

Operand normalisation (measured 2026-10-01, plan 03-01): match.dtk_operands' symbol pattern lets `@` continue a name,
so an unquoted operand with a relocation suffix and no addend (`lbl_806F4D60@sda21`, `lbl_X@ha`, `lbl_X@l`) is read as
the name `lbl_806F4D60@sda21` with no suffix and the word gets NO operand (None). judge() then reports
RELOC_TARGET_MISMATCH for every correct relocation of that form - a false negative of the instrument, never a false
MATCH. `operands()` feeds the oracle's own dtk_operands a block in which exactly that form is rewritten
`name@sfx` -> `name+0@sfx`, which the same pattern parses as (name, 0). Every operand the raw parser already resolved
is unchanged (gated over the real targets); the raw verdict is recorded beside the normalised one.
```

### candidate_ledger.py
```
The gex44 candidate ledger (SPEC "Candidate ledger", 02-CONTEXT D4): append-only, hash-chained JSONL at
F\candidate_ledger.jsonl, one row per attempt.

    python candidate_ledger.py verify [--path <jsonl>]
        -> CANDIDATE_LEDGER=OK rows=N reproduction=N candidates=C stale_input=K unique_candidates=U      (exit 0)
        -> CANDIDATE_LEDGER=BROKEN <first errors>                                            (exit 1)

Rows chain through stage.chain_append (seq / prev_hash / row_hash, the canon of the local match ledger). A reproduction
row (`reproduction: true`) re-proves a match that already exists locally: it never counts as a unique candidate and is
never exported. Model fields stay null for a reproduction (D6: no model is called). This module never edits a row.

A non-reproduction row (`reproduction: false`, plan 03-01 D-12) is a NEW candidate: it has its own miss vocabulary
(CANDIDATE_MISS_CLASSES) and carries the second oracle's answer in `oracle2`. Such a row may only be MATCH_CANDIDATE
with a job_id, a returned object_sha256, objdiff_result.match_percent == 100.0 AND oracle2.verdict == "MATCH" (D-05):
one oracle alone never makes a candidate.
```

### capsule_build.py
```
Build the first match capsule: a read-only, content-addressed bundle of exactly the inputs GEX44 matching needs for
the 298 proven units (5 sealed + 289 donors + 4 model matches), with sha256 per file, source commits, tool identities,
schema and created_at.

    python capsule_build.py [--ceiling-mb N] [--trim census] [--trim asm-slices] [--targets-from-donors] [--set-current]
        -> CAPSULE=<id> manifest_sha256=<hex> files=<n> bytes=<b> projected=<p> ceiling=<c> trim=<list> units=298 ...
        -> CAPSULE=EXISTS <id>                      (identical inputs, nothing rewritten)
        -> CAPSULE_REFUSED <CODE> <detail>          (exit 3; no capsule directory is left behind)
    python capsule_build.py --verify-current        -> VERIFY=OK | VERIFY=FAIL <reasons>

Producer data (ledger, registry, donors, census, split, L0 corpus, oracle files) is opened read-only and never written.
The capsule lands under F\capsules\<capsule_id>\ (outside git). The ceiling can only be lowered (C4: 68 MiB); the
only ways down when the whole-input capsule is over it are the explicit recorded trims `census` then `asm-slices`.
Nothing is ever dropped silently: no unit, no asm target, no object.

`--targets-from-donors` (plan 03-01, D-09) adds the TARGET OBJECT of every deterministic-family member: each census row
whose (primary, shape_id) is a DONORS shape with best MATCH, plus the single NO_TEMPLATE VIRTUAL_STUB shape - exactly
EXPECTED_TARGETS rows or TARGET_COUNT refuses. Each target's asm unit comes from the `.fn` index (and must equal the
census row's); its object is copied whole once under split/obj/ (shared with units, sha256 in source_commits.inputs);
its asm is NOT copied (GEX44 runner modes never read asm). The manifest gains `targets` and counts.targets /
counts.target_objects; without the flag the capsule is byte-for-byte what it was.
```

### stage.py
```
Authoring side of the ksr-match-batch custody chain (Windows laptop): build, validate, transport.

    python stage.py build --mode {inventory,batch,fixture,ramp} [--runner-source head|worktree] [--capsule CURRENT|<id>]
                          [--include-lmgr --justification <receipt.json>] [--red-control stale_capsule]
                          [--inventory <J1 receipt.json>  (ramp only)]
        -> BUILD=<tag> task_sha256=<hex> payload_sha256=<hex>          (exit 3 BUILD=REFUSED <code>, 14 PINS_NOT_LIVE)
           batch builds also print `admission.source=<ADMISSION_GEX44.json sha256 ...>` once the measured file exists
    python stage.py pins --verify               -> PINS=OK | PINS=FAIL <names>          (exit 0 / 1)
    python stage.py fit --capsule CURRENT|<id>  -> FIT=OK ... | FIT=OVER ...            (exit 0 / 1)
    python stage.py send <build_tag>            -> SEND=<result> job=<id>   (exit 4 STOPPED, 5 CAP_REACHED, 14 PINS_NOT_LIVE, ...)
    python stage.py wait <job_id> [--max-seconds N<=540]   -> WAIT=COLLECTED | WAIT=STILL_RUNNING (exit 2)
    python stage.py status                      -> parsed gex44_cli status

Nothing here opens a session to the compute host. The only legal remote is the VPS (RULE-090); the dispatcher moves
bytes to and from the compute host itself. Names and values are fixed by 01-CONTRACTS.md (C1-C9).

The live CLI (`build`, `send`) refuses when the resolved pins path is not the real G/pins.json (MATCH_ACCEL_GEX44_PINS
and an explicit path are drill-only): a build or send that used drill pins must never reach the compute host.
```

### repatriate.py
```
Return path, local half: verify a returned tree, ingest it once, and fetch it from the VPS.

    python repatriate.py <job_id>
        -> REPATRIATE=<verdict> ingest=<INGESTED|ALREADY_INGESTED|CONFLICT> tree=<sha256>   (scp from the VPS only)

    python repatriate.py --verify-only <dir> [--job-id ID]
        -> REPATRIATE=OK|INVALID_CUSTODY tree=<sha256>            (exit 0 only on OK)
    python repatriate.py --verify-only <returns_root> --latest-ingested
        -> REPATRIATE=<verdict> job=<id> tree=<sha256>            (re-verifies the last row of ingest_ledger.jsonl)

The returned tree is <root>/{collect.json, dispatch.log, run/...}. collect.json carries md5 per file (computed on the
VPS after the dispatcher extracted the collect stream); run/MANIFEST.json and run/SHA256SUMS carry the runner's own
sha256 per file. Both are re-checked here, the file set is compared both ways, and no path may be a link or reparse
point (threat T-01-04). Verdicts are OK | INVALID_CUSTODY (C7).
```

```python
def load_draw(path, anchor=DRAW_ANCHOR_SHA, holdout_prefix=HOLDOUT_PREFIX):
    """Draw entries IN STORED ORDER (= draw order, D1); entry i is position i+1."""
    if os.path.basename(path) == HOLDOUT_BASENAME:
        raise Refused("HOLDOUT_FORBIDDEN %s is never opened before checkpoint 300" % HOLDOUT_BASENAME)
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        obj = json.loads(fh.read().decode("utf-8"))
    d = obj.get("draw") if isinstance(obj, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(d, dict) or not isinstance(d.get("ids"), list) or not d["ids"]:
        raise Refused("DRAW_ANCHOR no draw.ids list in %s" % path)
    entries = d["ids"]
    for e in entries:
        for k in ("census_id", "class", "size_bucket", "bgroup"):
            if not isinstance(e, dict) or not isinstance(e.get(k), str):
                raise Refused("DRAW_ANCHOR draw entry lacks %s" % k)
    ids = [e["census_id"] for e in entries]
    if len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
        raise Refused("DRAW_ANCHOR duplicate census_id in draw")
    got = _id_sha(ids)
    if holdout_prefix and got.startswith(holdout_prefix):
        raise Refused("HOLDOUT_FORBIDDEN the id set hashes to the sealed holdout (%s...)" % holdout_prefix)
    if got != d.get("sorted_id_sha256"):
        raise Refused("DRAW_ANCHOR recomputed %s != recorded %s" % (got, d.get("sorted_id_sha256")))
    if anchor is not None and got != anchor:
        raise Refused("DRAW_ANCHOR recomputed %s != anchor %s" % (got, anchor))
    return entries
```

#### cohorts (line 92)
```python
def cohorts(entries, first, last, size=COHORT_SIZE):
    """Contiguous slices of positions first..last (1-based, draw order); one fresh process per cohort (amendment a)."""
    if not (1 <= first <= last <= len(entries)) or size < 1:
        raise Refused("COHORT_RANGE first=%s last=%s size=%s draw n=%d" % (first, last, size, len(entries)))
    out, pos, k = [], first, 1
    while pos <= last:
        hi = min(pos + size - 1, last)
        out.append({"k": k, "first": pos, "last": hi, "positions": [(p, entries[p - 1]) for p in range(pos, hi + 1)]})
        pos, k = hi + 1, k + 1
    return out
```

```python
def validate_record(rec):
    if not isinstance(rec, dict):
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID not an object")
    for k in RECORD_KEYS:
        if k not in rec:
            raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID missing key %s" % k)
    if rec["schema"] != RECORD_SCHEMA:
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID schema %r" % (rec["schema"],))
    if rec["arm"] not in ARMS:
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID arm %r" % (rec["arm"],))
    if not isinstance(rec["census_id"], str) or not rec["census_id"]:
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID census_id")
    for k in ("draw_pos", "cohort"):
        if not isinstance(rec[k], int) or isinstance(rec[k], bool) or rec[k] < 1:
            raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID %s %r" % (k, rec[k]))
    st = rec["stratum"]
    if not (isinstance(st, list) and len(st) == 3 and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in st)):
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID stratum must be [class, size_bucket, bgroup]")
    _check_value("host_plane", rec["host_plane"])
    if not (_is_absent(rec["host_plane"]) or (isinstance(rec["host_plane"], str) and rec["host_plane"])):
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID host_plane %r" % (rec["host_plane"],))
    if not (isinstance(rec["verdict"], str) and rec["verdict"]):
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID verdict")
    _check_value("verified", rec["verified"])
    if not (_is_absent(rec["verified"]) or isinstance(rec["verified"], bool)):
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID verified %r" % (rec["verified"],))
    cost = rec["cost"]
    if not isinstance(cost, dict):
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID cost not an object")
    for k in COST_KEYS:
        if k not in cost:
            raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID cost missing %s" % k)
        _check_value("cost.%s" % k, cost[k])
        if not (_is_num(cost[k]) or _is_absent(cost[k])):
            raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID cost.%s non-numeric %r" % (k, cost[k]))
    ad = rec["amendment_d"]
    if not isinstance(ad, dict):
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID amendment_d not an object")
    for k in AMEND_D_KEYS:
        if k not in ad:
            raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID amendment_d missing %s" % k)
        _check_value("amendment_d.%s" % k, ad[k])
        if isinstance(ad[k], (list, float)) and isinstance(ad[k], float) and not math.isfinite(ad[k]):
            raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID amendment_d.%s not finite" % k)
    return rec
```

#### run_cohort (line 184)
```python
def run_cohort(arm, cohort, executor=None, out=None):
    """Validate every record of the cohort, then append them all. executor(arm, entry, pos, cohort_k) -> dict with
    host_plane, verdict, verified, cost, amendment_d. None -> ARM_EXECUTOR_ABSENT, nothing written."""
    if arm not in ARMS:
        raise Refused("ARM_UNKNOWN %r" % (arm,))
    if executor is None:
        raise Refused("ARM_EXECUTOR_ABSENT %s" % arm)
    if not out:
        raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID no output path")
    have = {(r["arm"], r["census_id"]) for r in _read_jsonl(out)} if os.path.isfile(out) else set()
    recs = []
    for pos, entry in cohort["positions"]:
        body = executor(arm, entry, pos, cohort["k"])
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            raise Refused("RECORD_INVALID executor returned %s for %s" % (type(body).__name__, entry["census_id"]))
        rec = dict(body)
        rec.update({"schema": RECORD_SCHEMA, "arm": arm, "census_id": entry["census_id"], "draw_pos": pos,
                    "cohort": cohort["k"], "stratum": [entry["class"], entry["size_bucket"], entry["bgroup"]]})
        validate_record(rec)
        key = (arm, rec["census_id"])
        if key in have:
            raise Refused("DUPLICATE_RECORD %s %s" % key)
        have.add(key)
        recs.append(rec)
    _append_jsonl(out, recs)
    return recs
```

```python
def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("corpus")
    ap.add_argument("asm_root")
    ap.add_argument("out_dir")
    ap.add_argument("--module", default="main")
    ap.add_argument("--ids")
    ap.add_argument("--valid-syntax", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    m2c_flags = ["--target", "ppc-mwcc-c"] + (["--valid-syntax"] if a.valid_syntax else [])
    if not venv_ok(sys.executable, TOOLS):
        print("M2C_REFUSED: run with the factory venv python (pinned deps), not %s" % sys.executable)
        return 2
    sys.path.insert(0, M2C)
    from m2c.main import parse_flags, run  # noqa: E402  (pinned checkout, TOOLS.json)
    sys.setrecursionlimit(min(2 ** 31 - 1, 10 * sys.getrecursionlimit()))

    want = set(open(a.ids, encoding="utf-8").read().split()) if a.ids else None
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(a.corpus, encoding="utf-8")]
    rows = [r for r in rows if r["module"] == a.module and r.get("kind") == "FUNCTION" and (want is None or r["id"] in want)]
    asm_dir = os.path.join(a.asm_root, "asm") if a.module in ("main", "player") else os.path.join(a.asm_root, a.module, "asm")
    text, tables = blocks(asm_dir)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(a.out_dir, "c"), exist_ok=True)
    res = os.path.join(a.out_dir, "results.tsv")
    done = {l.split("\t", 1)[0] for l in open(res, encoding="utf-8")} if os.path.isfile(res) else set()
    n = 0
    with open(res, "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as w, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        for r in rows:
            if r["id"] in done:
                continue
            t0, status, err, c = time.perf_counter(), "OK", "", ""
            block = text.get(r["name"])
            if block is None:
                status, err = "NO_ASM_BLOCK", "no .fn block named %s" % r["name"]
            else:
                src = os.path.join(tmp, "fn.s")
                refs = sorted(set(TABLE_REF.findall(block)))
                missing = [t for t in refs if t not in tables]
                extra = []
                for t in refs:
                    if t in tables:
                        if r.get("start"):
                            block, tab = adapt_table(block, tables[t], r["name"], int(r["start"], 16))
                        else:
                            tab = tables[t]
                        extra.append(tab)
                open(src, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(block + "".join("\n" + t for t in extra))
                out, errbuf = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
                try:
                    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(errbuf):
                        rc = run(parse_flags(m2c_flags + [src]))
                    c = out.getvalue()
                    if rc != 0:
                        # m2c writes its failure reason into the output comment, not to stderr
                        why = errbuf.getvalue() or c
                        why = why[why.find("Decompilation failure"):] if "Decompilation failure" in why else why
                        why = why.strip().replace("/*", "").replace("*/", "")
                        status, err = "M2C_FAILED", " ".join(why.split())[:300] + (" missing_tables=%s" % missing if missing else "")
                except Exception as e:  # one function's failure is recorded, never propagated
                    status, err = "EXCEPTION", "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, str(e)[:300])
            if c:
                open(os.path.join(a.out_dir, "c", r["id"].replace(":", "_") + ".c"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(c)
            w.write("\t".join([r["id"], admit(status, c), "%.3f" % (time.perf_counter() - t0), str(c.count("M2C_ERROR")),
                               hashlib.sha256(c.encode()).hexdigest() if c else "", err.replace("\t", " ").replace("\n", " ")]) + "\n")
            w.flush()
            n += 1
    print("M2C_DONE rows=%d" % n)
    return 0
```

#### load_units (line 78)
```python
def load_units(path):
    """(rows, sha256 of the file bytes) of a units JSONL; every row must carry exactly the UNIT_KEYS."""
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_file():
        raise CandidateRefused("UNITS_MISSING", "no units file at %s" % p)
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    rows = []
    for n, line in enumerate(raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError as e:
            raise CandidateRefused("UNITS_INVALID", "line %d is not JSON: %s" % (n, e))
        if not isinstance(r, dict) or set(r) != set(UNIT_KEYS):
            got = sorted(r) if isinstance(r, dict) else type(r).__name__
            raise CandidateRefused("UNITS_INVALID", "line %d keys %s != %s" % (n, got, sorted(UNIT_KEYS)))
        rows.append(r)
    if not rows:
        raise CandidateRefused("UNITS_EMPTY", "no unit in %s" % p)
    return rows, sha256_bytes(raw)
```

#### build_units (line 101)
```python
def build_units(rows, manifest):
    """Task units from load_units rows, checked against the capsule manifest: source_sha256 added, the target a `.o`
    file of the manifest (and, when the manifest lists `targets`, the target recorded for that entity), preset flags
    equal to the capsule preset, a stated flags_delta for literal flags, no repeated unit or identical attempt, and the
    runner's own unit check passed. Pure: reads nothing."""
    files = manifest.get("files") or {}
    presets = manifest.get("presets") or {}
    targets = manifest.get("targets")
    by_entity = None if targets is None else dict((t.get("entity"), t) for t in targets)
    units, seen_ids, seen_attempts = [], set(), set()
    for r in rows:
        uid = r.get("unit_id")
        text = r.get("source_text")
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            raise CandidateRefused("UNIT_INVALID", "%s: source_text is not a string" % uid)
        u = dict((k, r[k]) for k in UNIT_KEYS)
        u["source_sha256"] = sha256_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))
        tgt = u["target_obj"]
        if not (isinstance(tgt, str) and tgt.endswith(".o") and tgt in files):
            raise CandidateRefused("TARGET_NOT_IN_CAPSULE", "%s: target_obj %r is not a .o file of the capsule manifest"
                                   % (uid, tgt))
        if by_entity is not None:
            rec = by_entity.get(u["entity"])
            if rec is None or rec.get("target_obj") != tgt or rec.get("symbol") != u["symbol"]:
                raise CandidateRefused("TARGET_NOT_IN_CAPSULE", "%s: entity %s / %s is not a capsule target with object %s"
                                       % (uid, u["entity"], u["symbol"], tgt))
        if u["preset"] is not None:
            if presets.get(u["preset"]) != u["flags"]:
                raise CandidateRefused("FLAGS_DISAGREE", "%s: flags differ from capsule preset %r" % (uid, u["preset"]))
        elif not (isinstance(u["flags_delta"], str) and u["flags_delta"].strip()):
            raise CandidateRefused("FLAGS_UNSTATED", "%s: literal flags (preset null) need a flags_delta" % uid)
        for key in ("producer", "strategy", "family", "variant"):
            if not (isinstance(u[key], str) and u[key]):
                raise CandidateRefused("UNIT_INVALID", "%s: %s must be a non-empty string" % (uid, key))
        if uid in seen_ids:
            raise CandidateRefused("UNIT_REPEATED", "unit_id %s appears twice" % uid)
        key = (u["entity"], u["source_sha256"], u["flags"])
        if key in seen_attempts:
            raise CandidateRefused("UNIT_REPEATED", "%s repeats an identical (entity, source, flags) attempt" % uid)
        seen_ids.add(uid)
        seen_attempts.add(key)
        try:
            runner_lib._check_candidate_unit(u, files)
        except runner_lib.RunnerError as e:
            raise CandidateRefused("UNIT_INVALID", "%s: %s" % (uid, e.details))
        units.append(u)
    return units
```

```python
def classify_unit(unit, row, derived, o2):
    """{class, rule, evidence}: MATCH, one of the D-12 classes, or UNCLASSIFIED (the judge then writes nothing)."""
    for name, rule in CLASSIFY_RULES:
        got = rule(unit, row, derived, o2)
        if got is not None:
            return {"class": got[0], "rule": name, "evidence": got[1]}
    return {"class": UNCLASSIFIED, "rule": None, "evidence": {"runner_status": (row or {}).get("runner_status")}}
```

```python
def judge_tree(tree, job_record, candidate_path, oracle=oracle2, current=None, pins=None, utcnow=None) -> dict:
    """Judge one returned candidate tree into the candidate ledger, one row per task unit, all rows or none.
    SHA256SUMS integrity -> custody.judge_receipt -> re-hash of every returned object -> oracle2 on the returned bytes
    -> D-12 class -> ledger. `job_record` = {job_id, params, task, task_sha256} from the LOCAL job dir."""
    job_id, params, task = job_record["job_id"], job_record["params"], job_record["task"]
    if task.get("mode") != "candidate":
        raise ValueError("NOT_CANDIDATE task mode %r" % task.get("mode"))
    if job_record.get("task_sha256") != params.get("task_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("TASK_DRIFT local task.json sha256 %s != params.task_sha256 %s"
                         % (job_record.get("task_sha256"), params.get("task_sha256")))
    prior = candidate_ledger.stage.chain_rows(candidate_path)
    existing = [r for r in prior if r.get("job_id") == job_id]
    if existing:
        raise ValueError("ALREADY_JUDGED %d candidate rows already name job %s" % (len(existing), job_id))
    out = reproduce.out_dir_of(tree)
    receipt = reproduce._load(out / "receipt.json")
    j = custody.judge_receipt(receipt, current, pins, expect=params)
    integrity = reproduce.verify_out(out)
    verdict, reasons = j["verdict"], list(j["reasons"])
    if integrity:
        verdict = "INVALID_CUSTODY"
        reasons.extend("OUT: %s" % p for p in integrity)
    rows_by = dict((r.get("unit_id"), r) for r in ((receipt.get("results") or {}).get("units") or [])
                   if isinstance(r, dict))
    planned, gaps = [], []
    for unit in task.get("units") or []:
        row = rows_by.get(unit["unit_id"])
        attempt = 1 + sum(1 for r in prior if r.get("entity") == unit["entity"]) \
            + sum(1 for p in planned if p["entity"] == unit["entity"])
        if verdict in ("STALE_INPUT", "INVALID_CUSTODY"):
            planned.append(_candidate_row(job_id, task, receipt, unit, row, None, None, verdict, "environment",
                                          "custody", {"custody": verdict, "reasons": reasons[:5]}, attempt, utcnow))
            continue
        d = rederive(out, unit, row)
        if d["disagrees"]:
            planned.append(_candidate_row(job_id, task, receipt, unit, row, d, None, "INVALID_CUSTODY", "environment",
                                          "returned_bytes", {"disagrees": d["disagrees"]}, attempt, utcnow))
            continue
        o2 = oracle(d["object"], unit["symbol"], unit["entity"], asm_unit_of(unit["target_obj"])) \
            if d["object"] is not None else None
        c = classify_unit(unit, row, d, o2)
        if c["class"] == UNCLASSIFIED:
            gaps.append(unit["unit_id"])
            continue
        status = "MATCH_CANDIDATE" if c["class"] == MATCH else candidate_ledger.STATUS_OF_CANDIDATE_CLASS[c["class"]]
        miss = None if c["class"] == MATCH else c["class"]
        planned.append(_candidate_row(job_id, task, receipt, unit, row, d, o2, status, miss, c["rule"], c["evidence"],
                                      attempt, utcnow))
    if gaps:
        raise ValueError("UNCLASSIFIED no classification rule fired for %s; nothing written" % gaps[:5])
    for p in planned:  # validate everything before the first append: all rows or none
        errs = candidate_ledger.validate(p)
        if errs:
            raise ValueError("CANDIDATE_ROW_INVALID %s: %s" % (p["unit_id"], "; ".join(errs[:3])))
    for p in planned:
        candidate_ledger.append(candidate_path, p)
    statuses = [p["status"] for p in planned]
    classes = {}
    for p in planned:
        k = "MATCH" if p["status"] == "MATCH_CANDIDATE" else (p["status"] if p["status"] in ("STALE_INPUT",
                                                                                          "INVALID_CUSTODY")
                                                              else p["miss_class"])
        classes[k] = classes.get(k, 0) + 1
    return {"verdict": verdict, "reasons": reasons, "units": len(planned),
            "match": statuses.count("MATCH_CANDIDATE"), "partial": statuses.count("PARTIAL"),
            "blocked": sum(1 for s in statuses if s.startswith("BLOCKED_")), "classes": classes,
            "rows": dict((p["unit_id"], {"status": p["status"], "miss_class": p["miss_class"],
                                         "match_percent": p["objdiff_result"]["match_percent"],
                                         "oracle2": (p["oracle2"] or {}).get("verdict")}) for p in planned),
            "job_verdict": receipt.get("verdict")}
```

```python
def cmd_judge(args) -> int:
    import stage
    import repatriate
    found = stage.find_job_record(args.job_id)
    if not found:
        print("CAND_JUDGE=ERROR no local job record names %s" % args.job_id)
        return 2
    job = reproduce.load_job(found[0].parent)
    tree = stage.gex44_root() / "returns" / args.job_id
    expect = {"job_id": args.job_id, "capsule_id": job["params"].get("capsule_id"),
              "task_sha256": job["params"].get("task_sha256")}
    v = repatriate.verify_tree(tree, expect)
    if v["verdict"] != "OK":
        print("CAND_JUDGE=INVALID_CUSTODY returned tree: %s" % "; ".join(v["reasons"][:3]))
        return 1
    try:
        cur = custody.current_capsule()
    except (custody.CurrentCapsuleMissing, ValueError):
        cur = None
    try:
        res = judge_tree(tree, job, candidate_ledger.default_path(), current=cur, pins=stage.load_pins())
    except (ValueError, OSError) as e:
        print("CAND_JUDGE=ERROR %s" % e)
        return 2
    print("CAND_JUDGE=%s units=%d match=%d partial=%d blocked=%d" % (res["verdict"], res["units"], res["match"],
                                                                     res["partial"], res["blocked"]))
    for uid, r in sorted(res["rows"].items()):
        print("  %s %s %s objdiff=%s oracle2=%s" % (uid, r["status"], r["miss_class"] or "-", r["match_percent"],
                                                    r["oracle2"]))
    return 0 if res["verdict"] == "OK" else 1
```

```python
def resolve_units(inp: dict):
    """Select and verify the 298 units. Everything refuses by name; nothing is guessed. Returns (units, ctx) where each
    unit carries its source bytes' path and ledger row, before the asm lookup."""
    ledger = _read_lines(inp["ledger"])
    rows = [r for _, r in ledger]
    by_seq = dict((r["seq"], (raw, r)) for raw, r in ledger)
    # sealed set: probe_v2 MATCH, distinct entities must equal the five
    sealed_rows = [(raw, r) for raw, r in ledger if r.get("producer") == "probe_v2" and r.get("verdict") == "MATCH"]
    ents = sorted(set(r["entity"] for _, r in sealed_rows))
    if ents != sorted(SEALED):
        raise CapsuleRefused("SEALED_SET_MISMATCH", "probe_v2 MATCH entities %s != the five sealed %s" % (ents, sorted(SEALED)))
    if len(sealed_rows) != len(SEALED):
        raise CapsuleRefused("SEALED_AMBIGUOUS", "%d probe_v2 MATCH rows for %d sealed entities" % (len(sealed_rows), len(SEALED)))
    reg_doc = json.loads(open(inp["registry"], "rb").read().decode("utf-8"))
    reg = dict((r["id"], r) for r in reg_doc["rows"])
    donors = [r for _, r in _read_lines(inp["donors"])]
    donor_ids_all = set(d["donor_id"] for d in donors)
    donor_rows = [d for d in donors if d.get("best") == "MATCH"]
    not_units = sorted(d["donor_id"] for d in donors if d.get("best") != "MATCH")
    missing = sorted(d["donor_id"] for d in donor_rows if d["donor_id"] not in reg)
    if missing:
        raise CapsuleRefused("DONOR_NOT_IN_REGISTRY", "donor ids absent from src_registry: %s" % missing[:5])
    if len(donor_rows) != EXPECTED_DONORS:
        raise CapsuleRefused("DONOR_COUNT", "%d MATCH donors != %d" % (len(donor_rows), EXPECTED_DONORS))
    model_ids = sorted(i for i in reg if i not in donor_ids_all)
    if model_ids != sorted(MODEL):
        raise CapsuleRefused("MODEL_SET_MISMATCH", "registry ids that are not donors %s != the four model matches %s" % (model_ids, sorted(MODEL)))

    units = []

    def add(kind, entity, raw_row, row, reg_row, extra):
        src_path = (reg_row or row)["source_path"]
        want_sha = row["source_sha256"]
        if reg_row is not None and reg_row["source_sha256"] != want_sha:
            raise CapsuleRefused("SOURCE_SHA_DISAGREE", "%s: registry %s != ledger %s" % (entity, reg_row["source_sha256"], want_sha))
        if reg_row is not None and reg_row.get("preset") != row.get("preset"):
            raise CapsuleRefused("PRESET_DISAGREE", "%s: registry %s != ledger %s" % (entity, reg_row.get("preset"), row.get("preset")))
        if not os.path.isfile(src_path):
            raise CapsuleRefused("SOURCE_MISSING", "%s: %s" % (entity, src_path))
        got = custody.sha256_file(src_path)
        if got != want_sha:
            raise CapsuleRefused("SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH", "%s: %s sha256 %s != producer row %s" % (entity, src_path, got, want_sha))
        if row.get("entity") != entity or row.get("verdict") != "MATCH":
            raise CapsuleRefused("LEDGER_ROW_MISMATCH", "%s: ledger seq %s is %s/%s" % (entity, row.get("seq"), row.get("entity"), row.get("verdict")))
        u = {"entity": entity, "symbol": row["name"], "kind": kind, "preset": row["preset"], "source_src": src_path,
             "source_sha256": want_sha, "asm_unit": row["asm_unit"], "ledger_seq": row["seq"], "ledger_producer": row.get("producer"),
             "local_object_sha256": row.get("object_sha256")}
        u.update(extra)
        units.append(u)

    for raw, r in sorted(sealed_rows, key=lambda x: SEALED.index(x[1]["entity"])):
        add("sealed", r["entity"], raw, r, None, {})
    for d in sorted(donor_rows, key=lambda x: x["donor_id"]):
        rr = reg[d["donor_id"]]
        seq = _seq_of(rr.get("origin"))
        if seq not in by_seq:
            raise CapsuleRefused("LEDGER_SEQ_MISSING", "%s: origin %r names no ledger row" % (d["donor_id"], rr.get("origin")))
        add("donor", d["donor_id"], by_seq[seq][0], by_seq[seq][1], rr,
            {"family": d.get("family"), "template": d.get("template"), "shape_id": d.get("shape_id")})
    for e in MODEL:
        rr = reg[e]
        seq = _seq_of(rr.get("origin"))
        if seq not in by_seq:
            raise CapsuleRefused("LEDGER_SEQ_MISSING", "%s: origin %r names no ledger row" % (e, rr.get("origin")))
        add("model", e, by_seq[seq][0], by_seq[seq][1], rr, {"origin": rr.get("origin")})
    if len(units) != EXPECTED_UNITS:
        raise CapsuleRefused("UNIT_COUNT", "%d units != %d" % (len(units), EXPECTED_UNITS))
    ctx = {"ledger_rows": rows, "sealed_raw": [raw for raw, _ in sorted(sealed_rows, key=lambda x: SEALED.index(x[1]["entity"]))],
           "donor_rows_not_units": not_units}
    return units, ctx
```

#### resolve_targets (line 337)
```python
def resolve_targets(inp: dict, idx: dict, obj_dir: str) -> list:
    """D-09: the target record of every deterministic-family member, sorted by entity. Refuses by name: TARGET_SHAPES
    (not exactly one NO_TEMPLATE VIRTUAL_STUB shape), TARGET_COUNT (!= EXPECTED_TARGETS), ASM_UNIT_MISMATCH (the `.fn`
    index does not name exactly the census row's unit), TARGET_OBJ_MISSING (no split object)."""
    donors = [r for _, r in _read_lines(inp["donors"])]
    shapes = {}
    for d in donors:
        if d.get("best") == "MATCH":
            shapes[(d["family"], d["shape_id"])] = d.get("template")
    stubs = [d for d in donors if d.get("template") == STUB_TEMPLATE and d.get("family") == STUB_FAMILY]
    if len(stubs) != 1:
        raise CapsuleRefused("TARGET_SHAPES", "%d NO_TEMPLATE VIRTUAL_STUB donor rows (need exactly 1)" % len(stubs))
    shapes[(stubs[0]["family"], stubs[0]["shape_id"])] = STUB_TEMPLATE
    targets = []
    with open(inp["census"], "rb") as f:
        for raw in f:
            if not raw.strip():
                continue
            r = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
            key = (r.get("primary"), r.get("shape_id"))
            if key not in shapes:
                continue
            found = idx.get(r["name"])
            if not found or found != [r.get("asm_unit")]:
                raise CapsuleRefused("ASM_UNIT_MISMATCH", "target %s (%s): .fn index %s, census asm_unit %s"
                                     % (r["id"], r["name"], found, r.get("asm_unit")))
            obj_name = found[0][:-2] + ".o"
            if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(obj_dir, obj_name)):
                raise CapsuleRefused("TARGET_OBJ_MISSING", "target %s: %s" % (r["id"], os.path.join(obj_dir, obj_name)))
            targets.append({"entity": r["id"], "symbol": r["name"], "asm_unit": found[0],
                            "target_obj": "split/obj/" + obj_name, "family": key[0], "shape_id": key[1],
                            "template": shapes[key]})
    if len(targets) != EXPECTED_TARGETS:
        raise CapsuleRefused("TARGET_COUNT", "%d deterministic-family targets != %d" % (len(targets), EXPECTED_TARGETS))
    if len(set(t["entity"] for t in targets)) != len(targets):
        raise CapsuleRefused("TARGET_COUNT", "a census entity appears twice among the targets")
    return sorted(targets, key=lambda t: t["entity"])
```

```python
def build(out_root=None, ceiling_bytes=custody.CAPSULE_CEILING_BYTES, trim=(), set_current=False, inputs=None,
          created_at=None, log=print, targets_from_donors=False):
    inp = default_inputs()
    inp.update(inputs or {})
    trim = list(trim)
    bad = [t for t in trim if t not in custody.TRIM_VOCABULARY]
    if bad or len(set(trim)) != len(trim):
        raise CapsuleRefused("TRIM_INVALID", "trim %s not from %s" % (trim, list(custody.TRIM_VOCABULARY)))
    trim = [t for t in custody.TRIM_VOCABULARY if t in trim]
    if ceiling_bytes > custody.CAPSULE_CEILING_BYTES:
        raise CapsuleRefused("CEILING_RAISED", "ceiling %d is above CAPSULE_CEILING_BYTES %d" % (ceiling_bytes, custody.CAPSULE_CEILING_BYTES))
    out_root = out_root or os.path.join(custody.gex44_root(), "capsules")

    units, ctx = resolve_units(inp)
    split_out = os.path.join(inp["split_dir"], "out")
    asm_dir, obj_dir = os.path.join(split_out, "asm"), inp.get("obj_dir") or os.path.join(split_out, "obj")

    # presets from the oracle match.py, cross-checked against every ledger row that names one
    match_py = open(os.path.join(inp["oracle_dir"], "match.py"), "rb").read()
    base_flags, presets = eval_presets(match_py)
    for r in ctx["ledger_rows"]:
        if r.get("preset") is None:
            continue
        if presets.get(r["preset"]) != r.get("flags"):
            raise CapsuleRefused("PRESET_MISMATCH", "ledger seq %s preset %s flags %r != oracle %r"
                                 % (r.get("seq"), r["preset"], r.get("flags"), presets.get(r["preset"])))
    for u in units:
        u["flags"] = presets[u["preset"]]

    # asm lookup: the unit defining each symbol must be unique and equal the ledger's asm_unit
    idx = asm_index(asm_dir)
    for u in units:
        found = idx.get(u["symbol"])
        if not found or found != [u["asm_unit"]]:
            raise CapsuleRefused("ASM_UNIT_MISMATCH", "%s (%s): .fn index %s, ledger asm_unit %s" % (u["entity"], u["symbol"], found, u["asm_unit"]))
        obj = os.path.join(obj_dir, u["asm_unit"][:-2] + ".o")
        if not os.path.isfile(obj):
            raise CapsuleRefused("TARGET_OBJ_MISSING", "%s: %s" % (u["entity"], obj))
    targets = resolve_targets(inp, idx, obj_dir) if targets_from_donors else None

    sources = {}
    for u in units:
        sources[u["entity"]] = open(u["source_src"], "rb").read()
    context_headers = scan_context(sources, set(["macros.inc"]))

    os.makedirs(out_root, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".build-", dir=out_root)
    try:
        return _stage_and_seal(inp, units, ctx, presets, idx, asm_dir, obj_dir, split_out, sources, context_headers, tmp,
                               out_root, ceiling_bytes, trim, set_current, created_at, log, targets)
    finally:
        if os.path.isdir(tmp):
            shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
```

```python
def build(mode: str, runner_source: str = "head", created_at=None, utcnow=None, root=None, capsule=None,
          include_lmgr: bool = False, justification=None, red_control=None, state=None, inventory=None,
          admission=None, entities=None, reproduce_inputs=None, candidate_units=None) -> dict:
    """Write F/jobs/<mode>-<UTC>/ with the four staged files, params.json and build_record.json.

    Pins come from load_pins() alone (explicit > MATCH_ACCEL_GEX44_PINS > G/pins.json); a missing file raises
    PinsMissing and nothing is written. Every refusal (BuildRefused, PinsMissing, ValueError) happens before the job dir
    exists: pin drift, lmgr gate, payload fit, capsule problems, an invalid admission file, a missing inventory receipt.
    inventory/batch carry the pinned tools and no capsule; fixture carries the capsule and no tools; ramp carries the
    capsule, the compiler tools and the pinned permuter source (lmgr DLLs only through the C9 gate). candidate carries the
    capsule, the compiler tools, the admission block and the units of `candidate_units` (a units JSONL path, read by
    candidate.load_units and checked against the capsule by candidate.build_units before anything is written)."""
    now = utcnow() if utcnow else datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    if mode not in runner_lib.SUPPORTED_MODES:
        raise ValueError("MODE_UNSUPPORTED %r" % mode)
    if red_control is not None and not (red_control in RED_CONTROLS and mode in RED_CONTROL_MODES):
        raise BuildRefused("RED_CONTROL_INVALID", "red control %r is not valid for mode %s" % (red_control, mode))
    if mode != "reproduce" and (entities is not None or reproduce_inputs is not None):
        raise BuildRefused("ENTITIES_NOT_ALLOWED", "entities / reproduce inputs are for mode reproduce only")
    if mode != "candidate" and candidate_units is not None:
        raise BuildRefused("UNITS_NOT_ALLOWED", "a units file is for mode candidate only")
    if mode == "candidate" and candidate_units is None:
        raise BuildRefused("UNITS_REQUIRED", "mode candidate needs --units <jsonl>")
    ramp = ramp_block(inventory) if mode == "ramp" else None
    adm = admission_block(admission) if mode in ADMISSION_MODES else None
    if mode in CAPSULE_MODES and capsule is None:
        raise BuildRefused("CAPSULE_REQUIRED", "mode %s needs --capsule CURRENT|<id>" % mode)
    if mode not in CAPSULE_MODES and capsule is not None:
        raise BuildRefused("CAPSULE_NOT_ALLOWED", "mode %s runs with capsule_id none" % mode)
    base = Path(root) if root else gex44_root()
    pins_file = pins_path()
    pins = load_pins()  # PinsMissing: there is no empty-pins fallback
    pins_sha = sha256_bytes(pins_file.read_bytes())
    auth = None
    if include_lmgr:
        auth = lmgr_authorization(justification, state)
        if not auth["authorized"]:
            raise BuildRefused(auth["reason"], "lmgr DLLs refused (justification=%s)" % (justification or "none"))
    problems = verify_pins(pins)
    if problems:
        raise BuildRefused("PIN_DRIFT", "; ".join(problems))
    tools = tools_for_mode(mode, pins, include_lmgr)
    cap, fit = None, None
    if mode in CAPSULE_MODES:
        cap = resolve_capsule(capsule, base)
        fit = payload_fit(cap["manifest"], pins, cap["manifest_bytes"])
        if not fit["fits"]:
            raise BuildRefused("FIT_OVER", json.dumps(fit, sort_keys=True))
        tree = custody.verify_manifest(cap["dir"], cap["manifest"])
        if not tree["ok"]:
            raise BuildRefused("CAPSULE_TREE_DRIFT", json.dumps(dict((k, v[:5]) for k, v in tree.items() if k != "ok")))
    repro_units, selection = None, None
    if mode == "reproduce":
        import reproduce  # lazy: reproduce -> candidate_ledger -> stage
        inp = dict(reproduce_inputs or {})
        try:
            repro_units, selection = reproduce.build_units(
                cap["manifest"], cap["capsule_id"], entities=entities,
                ledger=inp.get("ledger", reproduce.LOCAL_LEDGER), obj_dir=inp.get("obj_dir", reproduce.LOCAL_OBJ_DIR),
                pins=pins)
        except reproduce.ReproduceRefused as e:
            raise BuildRefused(e.code, e.detail)
    cand_units, cand_selection = None, None
    if mode == "candidate":
        import candidate  # lazy: candidate -> reproduce -> candidate_ledger -> stage
        try:
            rows, units_sha = candidate.load_units(candidate_units)
            cand_units = candidate.build_units(rows, cap["manifest"])
        except candidate.CandidateRefused as e:
            raise BuildRefused(e.code, e.detail)
        producers = sorted(set(u["producer"] for u in cand_units))
        cand_selection = {"units_file_sha256": units_sha, "producer": producers[0] if len(producers) == 1 else producers,
                          "phase": CURRENT_PHASE, "capsule_id": cap["capsule_id"], "units": len(cand_units)}
    payload_files = {}
    for name, ent in tools.items():
        data = Path(ent["local_path"]).read_bytes()
        if sha256_bytes(data) != ent["sha256"]:
            raise BuildRefused("PIN_DRIFT", "%s changed between verify and packing" % name)
        payload_files[ent["member"]] = data
```

```python
def send(tag, remote=None, preflight=None, sleep=time.sleep, clock=time.monotonic, utcnow=None,
         running_window_s=RUNNING_WINDOW_S, poll_every_s=RUNNING_POLL_S, root=None, live=False) -> dict:
    """Guards in order, stopping at the first refusal (recorded in job_record.json): [live only: the resolved and the
    recorded pins path must be the real G/pins.json, and the data root must be the factory root F], STOP, job cap,
    params, route preflight, boots + idle queue,
    staging with sha256 read-back, then one hash-chained ledger row per queue add BEFORE the add, and confirmation that
    the job reaches running. `live` is set by the CLI only; drills call send() without it. Returns {result, exit, record}."""
    base = Path(root) if root else gex44_root()
    jdir = base / "jobs" / tag
    ledger = base / "jobs_ledger.jsonl"
    now = lambda: (utcnow() if utcnow else datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))  # noqa: E731
    rec = {"tag": tag, "started_at": utc_iso(now()), "result": None, "add_attempts": []}

    def save():
        if jdir.is_dir():
            (jdir / "job_record.json").write_bytes(canon_task_bytes(rec))

    def finish(result, **extra):
        rec.update(extra)
        rec["result"] = result
        rec["finished_at"] = utc_iso(now())
        save()
        return {"result": result, "exit": EXIT_CODES[result], "record": rec}

    if live:
        # both live checks precede STOP and the cap: those two read `base`, so a non-factory root must refuse first
        problem = live_pins_problem() or recorded_pins_problem(jdir)
        if problem:
            return finish("PINS_NOT_LIVE", refusal=problem)
        problem = live_root_problem(base)
        if problem:
            return finish("ROOT_NOT_LIVE", refusal=problem)
    if (base / "STOP").exists():
        return finish("STOPPED", refusal="STOP file present: %s" % (base / "STOP"))
    phase, cap = root_phase_cap(base)
    n_rows = phase_add_count(chain_rows(ledger), phase)
    if n_rows >= cap:
        return finish("CAP_REACHED", refusal="phase %d: %d queue adds already recorded, cap %d"
                      % (phase, n_rows, cap))
    try:
        params = json.loads((jdir / "params.json").read_bytes().decode("utf-8"))
        validate_params(params)
        local_sha = dict((n, sha256_bytes((jdir / n).read_bytes())) for n in STAGED_FILES)
        task = json.loads((jdir / "task.json").read_bytes().decode("utf-8"))
        if local_sha["task.json"] != params["task_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("task.json sha256 differs from params.task_sha256")
        if local_sha["payload.tar"] != task.get("payload_sha256"):
            raise ValueError("payload.tar sha256 differs from task.payload_sha256")
        for n in RUNNER_FILES:
            if local_sha[n] != task.get("runner", {}).get(n):
                raise ValueError("%s sha256 differs from task.runner" % n)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
        return finish("INVALID_PARAMS", refusal=str(e))
    rec.update({"params": params, "task_sha256": params["task_sha256"], "source_commit": task.get("source_commit"),
                "payload_sha256": task.get("payload_sha256")})

    rc, text = (preflight or _default_preflight)(jdir)
    ok = rc == 0 and bool(PREFLIGHT_OK.search(text or ""))
    rec["preflight"] = {"path": str(jdir / "preflight.json"), "rc": rc, "verdict": "ROUTABLE" if ok else "BLOCKED"}
    if not ok:
        return finish("PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED", refusal="route preflight did not say ROUTABLE (rc=%s)" % rc)

    remote = remote or Remote()
    try:
        st = parse_status(remote.status_text())
    except RemoteError as e:
        return finish("REMOTE_ERROR", refusal="status read failed: %s" % e)
    rec["status_before"] = st
    if st["boots_used"] is None or st["boots_total"] is None:
        return finish("BOOTS_LIMIT", refusal="boots_last_24h unparseable: %r" % st["boots_last_24h"])
    if st["boots_used"] >= st["boots_total"] - BOOTS_RESERVE:
        return finish("BOOTS_LIMIT", refusal="boots_last_24h %s leaves no reserve" % st["boots_last_24h"])
    if st["current_job_id"] is not None or st["queue_depth"] != 0:
        return finish("NOT_IDLE", refusal="current_job_id=%r queue_depth=%r" % (st["current_job_id"], st["queue_depth"]))

    try:
        remote.mkdir_stage()
        before = remote.stage_sha256(STAGED_FILES)
        uploads = [n for n in STAGED_FILES if before.get(n) != local_sha[n]]
        for n in uploads:
            remote.upload(jdir / n, n)
        after = remote.stage_sha256(STAGED_FILES)
    except RemoteError as e:
        return finish("REMOTE_ERROR", refusal="staging failed: %s" % e)
    rec["uploads"], rec["vps_sha256_after"] = uploads, after
    bad = [n for n in STAGED_FILES if after.get(n) != local_sha[n]]
    if bad:
        return finish("STAGING_MISMATCH", refusal="VPS sha256 differs after upload: %s" % bad)

    job_id = "ksrmb-" + now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    rec["job_id"] = job_id
    attempt = 1
    while True:
        if phase_add_count(chain_rows(ledger), phase) >= cap:
            return finish("CAP_REACHED", refusal="phase %d: the queue add would exceed the cap %d"
                          % (phase, cap), **({"readd_refused": "CAP_REACHED"} if attempt > 1 else {}))
        row = chain_append(ledger, {"job_id": job_id, "kind": "add" if attempt == 1 else "re-add", "attempt": attempt,
                                    "mode": params["mode"], "task_sha256": params["task_sha256"],
                                    "at": utc_iso(now()), "phase": phase})
        rc, out = remote.queue_add(job_id, params)
        rec["add_attempts"].append({"attempt": attempt, "row_hash": row["row_hash"], "rc": rc,
                                    "output_tail": (out or "")[-300:], "at": utc_iso(now())})
        if attempt == 1:
            rec["queued_at"] = utc_iso(now())
        save()
        if rc not in (0, 255):
            return finish("ADD_FAILED", refusal="gex44_cli queue add rc=%s" % rc)
        try:
            state, last_text = _poll_running(remote, job_id, running_window_s, poll_every_s, sleep, clock)
            if state == "RUNNING":
                return finish("RUNNING", running_confirmed_at=utc_iso(now()))
            if _seen(remote, job_id, last_text):
                return finish("QUEUED_NOT_RUNNING", refusal="job is queued or collected but not current after %ss"
                              % running_window_s)
        except RemoteError as e:
            return finish("REMOTE_ERROR", refusal="polling failed: %s" % e)
        if attempt >= 2:
            return finish("LOST", refusal="the job vanished twice from status and queue")
        attempt = 2
```

```python
def wait(job_id, max_seconds, remote=None, sleep=time.sleep, clock=time.monotonic, root=None) -> str:
    """COLLECTED once <VPS return>/<job_id>/collect.json exists, STILL_RUNNING at the deadline. After COLLECTED the
    status is re-read and stored as status_after (boots included) in the job record."""
    if not JOB_ID_SAFE.match(job_id):
        raise ValueError("unsafe job id %r" % job_id)
    remote = remote or Remote()
    path = "%s/%s/collect.json" % (VPS_RETURN_ROOT, job_id)
    deadline = clock() + max_seconds
    while True:
        if remote.file_exists(path):
            after = parse_status(remote.status_text())
            found = find_job_record(job_id, root)
            if found:
                found[1]["status_after"] = after
                found[1]["collected_seen_at"] = utc_iso()
                found[0].write_bytes(canon_task_bytes(found[1]))
            return "COLLECTED"
        now = clock()
        if now >= deadline:
            return "STILL_RUNNING"
        sleep(min(WAIT_POLL_S, deadline - now))
```

#### _check_candidate_unit (line 1348)
```python
def _check_candidate_unit(unit, files):
    """A candidate unit from the (hash-verified) task re-validated against the VERIFIED capsule manifest `files` before
    any byte of it becomes a path, a file or an argv (T-03-01). INVALID_CUSTODY on anything off."""
    if not isinstance(unit, dict):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "a candidate unit is not an object")
    uid, ent, sym = unit.get("unit_id"), unit.get("entity"), unit.get("symbol")
    if not (isinstance(uid, str) and JOB_ID_RE.match(uid)):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit_id %s" % clip(uid))
    if not (isinstance(ent, str) and ENTITY_RE.match(ent)):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s entity %s" % (uid, clip(ent)))
    if not (isinstance(sym, str) and SYMBOL_RE.match(sym)):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s symbol %s" % (uid, clip(sym)))
    text = unit.get("source_text")
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s carries no source_text" % uid)
    data = text.encode("utf-8")
    if len(data) > CANDIDATE_SOURCE_MAX_BYTES:
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s source_text is %d bytes > %d" % (uid, len(data),
                                                                                     CANDIDATE_SOURCE_MAX_BYTES))
    want = unit.get("source_sha256")
    if not (isinstance(want, str) and HEX64.match(want)) or sha256_bytes(data) != want:
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s source_text sha256 differs from source_sha256" % uid)
    if CANDIDATE_INCLUDE_RE.search(text):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s source_text carries an #include" % uid)
    if CANDIDATE_ASM_RE.search(text):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s source_text carries inline asm / opword / data words" % uid)
    rel = unit.get("target_obj")
    if not (isinstance(rel, str) and rel.endswith(".o") and not _bad_member_name("capsule/" + rel) and rel in files):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s target_obj %s is not a .o file of the verified capsule"
                          % (uid, clip(rel)))
    flags = unit.get("flags")
    tokens = flags.split() if isinstance(flags, str) else []
    if not tokens or not all(FLAG_RE.match(t) for t in tokens):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s flags rejected %s" % (uid, clip(flags)))
    echo = {}
    for key in CANDIDATE_ECHO_KEYS:
        v = unit.get(key)
        if v is not None and not (isinstance(v, str) and len(v) <= 160):
            raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "unit %s %s is neither null nor a short string" % (uid, key))
        echo[key] = v
    out = {"unit_id": uid, "entity": ent, "symbol": sym, "source_text": text, "source_sha256": want,
           "target_obj": rel, "flags": flags}
    out.update(echo)
    return out
```

```python
def mode_candidate(ctx):
    """Per unit: admission, compile the unit's own source text (tools/units/<uid>/fn.c, cwd that dir) with the staged
    certified mwcceppc under wibo, objdiff against the capsule target object. Never judges a match: the second oracle
    and the verdict live in the local judge."""
    params, task, budget, log = ctx["params"], ctx["task"], ctx["budget"], ctx["log"]
    if params.get("capsule_id") in (None, "none") or task.get("capsule_id") in (None, "none"):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_PARAMS", "candidate mode needs a capsule")
    root = _rel_path(ctx["work_dir"], "capsule")
    with open(_rel_path(root, "MANIFEST.json"), "rb") as mf:
        files = json.loads(mf.read().decode("utf-8")).get("files") or {}
    units = task.get("units")
    if not isinstance(units, list) or not units:
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "candidate task carries no units")
    checked = [_check_candidate_unit(u, files) for u in units]
    if len(set(u["unit_id"] for u in checked)) != len(checked):
        raise RunnerError("INVALID_CUSTODY", "candidate task repeats a unit_id")
    constants = _admission_constants(task)
    objd = _tool_abs(ctx, "objdiff_cli")
    if objd is None:
        raise RunnerError("TOOL_FAILURE", "candidate needs objdiff_cli in task.tools")
    sleep = ctx.get("sleep") or time.sleep
    cpu = ctx.get("cpu_window")
    own_cpu = cpu is None
    if own_cpu:
        cpu = CpuWindow(reader=ctx["host"].cpu_reader(), interval_s=getattr(ctx["host"], "cpu_interval_s", 1.0))
        cpu.start()
        cpu.wait_ready(CPU_READY_WAIT_S)
    tools_dir = os.path.join(ctx["work_dir"], "tools")
    out_units = os.path.join(ctx["stage_dir"], "out", "units")
    os.makedirs(out_units, exist_ok=True)
    results, stopped, prefer = [], None, None
    try:
        for unit in checked:
            uid = unit["unit_id"]
            try:
                budget.check("candidate:%s" % uid)
            except RunnerError as e:
                stopped = "BUDGET %s" % e.details
                log.append(stopped)
                break
            adm, reasons = _admit_unit(ctx, cpu, constants, sleep)
            row = {"unit_id": uid, "entity": unit["entity"], "symbol": unit["symbol"], "flags": unit["flags"],
                   "target_obj": unit["target_obj"], "source_sha256": unit["source_sha256"],
                   "admission": adm, "admission_checks": len(reasons), "admission_reasons": reasons, "compile": None,
                   "compiled_source_sha256": None, "object_sha256": None, "object_size": 0, "text_sha256": None,
                   "text_bytes": None, "objdiff": None, "wall_s": None, "cpu_s": None}
            for key in CANDIDATE_ECHO_KEYS:
                row[key] = unit[key]
            if adm["verdict"] != "ADMIT":
                row["runner_status"] = "ADMISSION_REFUSED"
                results.append(row)
                stopped = "ADMISSION_REFUSED at %s after %d checks" % (uid, len(reasons))
                log.append(stopped)
                break
            data = unit["source_text"].encode("utf-8")
            row["compiled_source_sha256"] = sha256_bytes(data)
            comp = _compile_unit(ctx, unit, prefer, subdir=uid, data=data)
            row["compile"] = _repro_compile_block(comp)
            walls = [row["compile"]["wall_s"]]
            cpus = [row["compile"]["cpu_s"]]
            udir = os.path.join(tools_dir, "units", uid)
            if not comp["ok"]:
                row["runner_status"] = "COMPILE_FAILED"
            else:
                prefer = comp["wibo_variant_ok"]
                row.update(_object_facts(os.path.join(udir, "fn.o")))
                target = _rel_path(root, unit["target_obj"])
                r = ctx["host"].run([objd, "diff", "-1", target, "-2", "fn.o", unit["symbol"], "-o", "fn.diff.json",
                                     "--format", "json"], udir, COMPILE_TIMEOUT_S)
                pct = parse_objdiff_percent(os.path.join(udir, "fn.diff.json"), unit["symbol"])
                row["objdiff"] = {"rc": r["rc"], "match_percent": pct, "wall_s": r["wall_s"], "cpu_s": r.get("cpu_s"),
                                  "stderr_tail": r["stderr_tail"]}
                row["objdiff"].update(rss_fields(r))
                walls.append(r["wall_s"])
                cpus.append(r.get("cpu_s"))
                row["runner_status"] = "DIFFED"
                shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(udir, "fn.o"), os.path.join(out_units, uid + ".o"))
                if (pct is None or float(pct) != 100.0) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(udir, "fn.diff.json")):
                    shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(udir, "fn.diff.json"), os.path.join(out_units, uid + ".diff.json"))
            row["wall_s"] = round(sum(w for w in walls if isinstance(w, (int, float))), 3)
            known = [c for c in cpus if isinstance(c, (int, float))]
            row["cpu_s"] = round(sum(known), 3) if known and len(known) == len(cpus) else None
            log.append("unit %s %s" % (uid, row["runner_status"]))
            results.append(row)
    finally:
        if own_cpu:
            cpu.stop()
    attempted = [r for r in results if r.get("runner_status") in ("COMPILE_FAILED", "DIFFED")]
    res = {"units": results, "candidate": {"units_total": len(checked), "attempted": len(attempted),
                                           "diffed": sum(r["runner_status"] == "DIFFED" for r in results),
                                           "compile_failed": sum(r["runner_status"] == "COMPILE_FAILED" for r in results)}}
    if stopped or len(attempted) != len(checked):
        res["stopped"] = stopped or "only %d of %d units attempted" % (len(attempted), len(checked))
        err = RunnerError("TOOL_FAILURE", "candidate stopped: %s" % res["stopped"])
        err.partial_results = res
        raise err
    return res
```
